ax.legend()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
names = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G']
y1 = [134.5, 63.7, 114.2, 10.1, 126.5, 148.9, 145.5]

y3 = [18.2, 106.8, 29.0, 188.5, 8.2, 305.3, 26.0]

bottom = [0] * len(names)

    ax.bar(names, ys, bottom=bottom, color=c, label=lab)
    bottom = [b + v for b, v in zip(bottom, ys)]
ax.grid(True, axis='y')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=3)
ax.set_title('Overall Expense by Location')
fig.savefig('chart.png')
